Team / Emily,

Quick heads-up: while reconciling AR aging for StratusTech we found a $14,250 credit that posted to Redwood EMEA (legal entity: Redwood Ltd) but should have applied to Redwood Inc (US). Because the credit was applied to the wrong entity the VAT flags and invoice-level balances are off in both ledgers and the revenue recognition mapping for the related invoices is now inconsistent.

I've attached the preliminary AR extract (AR_statement_StratusTech_Q2_2026.xlsx) showing the credit memo (CM-789) and the impacted invoices (INV-2041, INV-2042). Can the finance team: 
- Confirm whether the credit can be reversed and applied to Redwood Inc?
- If so, what journal do we need and the timing for reversing revenue recognition entries (if any)?

Emily — please confirm whether StratusTech is able to reissue the credit memo under the US VAT/buyer entity if required.

Next steps I propose: Marcus + Monica to prepare reversing JV + re-apply credit; Lauren to sign off on the revmap change; Alex to confirm with StratusTech on VAT reissue.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez

> Quick heads-up: while reconciling AR aging for StratusTech we found a $14,250 credit ...

I pulled the application history — payment trace shows the funds cleared via our EU bank on 2026-06-28 which is why the credit posted to Redwood Ltd. We can reverse and move but note the tax treatment: if we move the credit to Redwood Inc we need StratusTech to issue a new credit memo that references the US VAT/buyer party so our tax engine will pick it up correctly.

I attached a journal_reverse_template.csv with the reversing JV lines and the reallocation JV blueprint. Revmap to use for the corrected recognition will be RM-STR-2026-08 (we'll need Lauren's sign-off). Estimated GL impact: 
- AR reallocation gross: $14,250
- Estimated revenue recognition reclass: $12,400 deferred -> recognized reversal in US books until corrected.

Monica — please plan to run the manual reallocation on 2026-08-03 close slot; after reallocation run an AR aging export and send back to Alex/Emily for confirmation.
